title: A pest or a disease
description: What commonly troubles a crop, named once and in every language, so that a crop lists keys rather than five translations of the same name. One file each: a pest in garden/pests/<key>.json, a disease or a disorder in garden/diseases/<key>.json.

key.description: The record's key and the file's name, the one field without a source.

name.description: The everyday name in each language.

name_latin.description: The scientific name of the organism, or of the group of them, the same in every language. Absent for a disorder no organism causes.
